sources.label: Custom Curve Pay patches for Morphe Manager
sources.author: Local Android
patch_list: Disables Curve's local signing-certificate mismatch check so any APK signing key can be used. Other device checks, login and server integrity remain unchanged.
Adds Batch GBIT to Launchpad. Select purchases, choose one funding card and follow sequential moves in a foreground progress notification. Curve eligibility and fees still apply.
Disables known analytics, marketing, crash and performance reporting. Removes Braze promotions and attribution. Account, payment, security and support services still communicate with their servers.
Hides Flex cards, promotions, transaction actions, settings and navigation. Does not cancel Flex or change the payment source.
Adds Patches settings for Hide Flex and hiding selected Launchpad tiles.
Plain feature names and copy in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Lithuanian and Norwegian. Adds an optional switch in Patches. Keeps Go Back in Time, Magic link, Fronted and Flex.
